messages:
Aisha: Starting a thread to align on marketplace private-offer onboarding for AWS/GCP/Azure. Need final packaging decisions: SKU schema, images (AMI vs VM image vs container), required regions, and trial wording for listing. Can we do a quick sync?
Diego: Quick notes: AWS uses AMI ids, Azure wants a managed VM offer + image gallery ids, GCP wants a productId + version. We should prepare modality-specific fields but keep a canonical CSV for ingestion.
Priya: SKU schema proposal: rw-inference.<edition>.<units>.<regionCode>. Example: rw-inference.pro.4.us. This keeps it short for offer pages. Include metadata columns: arch, gpu_required, billing_period, trial_days.
Omar: For regions, recommended minimum: us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1. GOV/cloudspecial: us-gov-west-1 and eu-west-2 if we enable Gov/EU instances. Mark ap-northeast-1 as optional GA.
Aisha: Note on images: our x86_64 AMIs exist in the three mandatory regions. arm64 AMIs are only in us-east-1 for now. Azure shared image gallery has only x86. GCP container-based listing can point to container image in Artifact Registry.
LegalBot: Legal checklist: Must attach DPA reference, export control clause, and trial conversion opt-in. Suggest trial_days <= 14 and explicit opt-in for auto-billing with cancel instructions. Also need standard indemnity paragraph for third-party images.
Priya: Can we embed trial copy verbatim in the CSV for display? Marketplace ingestion usually accepts a short blurb field. Proposed copy: "Try Redwood Inference free for up to 14 days. Cancel anytime during trial to avoid charges. By starting the trial you agree to automatic conversion to paid billing unless cancelled."
Diego: We also need SKU metadata about instance-class support: cpu_only, gpu_t4, gpu_a100. Some customers will filter by GPU support. Add column instance_types="c5|g4|p4" pattern.
Omar: Ops note: for AWS private offers we need seller-defined pricing and the private offer ID at ingestion. I'll add the draft private_offer_id to the checklist once we have final SKUs.
Aisha: Action items: (1) Diego to export AMI/VM/image ids and region availability (due TOM). (2) Priya to publish canonical CSV template with columns: sku,display_name,edition,units,region,arch,instance_types,gpu_required,price_period,trial_days,sku_metadata_url (due EOD). (3) Omar to draft private_offer_id and seller pricing payload. (4) LegalBot to paste final trial/EULA snippet + DPA link.
Priya: Uploaded a sample CSV in the checklist page: ``sku,display_name,edition,units,region,arch,instance_types,price_period,trial_days,extra_metadata_url
rw-inference.pro.4.us,Redwood Inference Pro - 4 units,pro,4,us-east-1,x86_64,c5|g4,monthly,14,https://artifacts.redwood/sku/pro-4-metadata.json``
Diego: AMI/VM draft posted: aws: ami-rl-x86-20260301 (us-east-1|us-west-2|eu-west-1), ami-rl-arm-20260301 (us-east-1 only). azure: sig:rl-pro-gallery:version:3 (eu + us regions). gcp: container image gcr.io/redwood/rl:20260301.
marketplace-lint-bot: Lint results: 4 issues found 11: missing DPA_attachment, 12: ambiguous region tag for arm AMI, 33: sku length > 64 chars for display_name, 47: price_currency missing for some SKUs. See /lint/1718889999-report.json
LegalBot: Pasted EULA excerpt: "Trial license limited to 14 days. Activation of trial constitutes agreement to automatic conversion to paid subscription unless cancelled prior to trial termination. Data processing governed by Redwood DPA v2: https://legal.redwood/dpa-v2. Export restrictions apply."
Omar: I filled price_currency=USD in the CSV and corrected display_name to be under 64 chars. Updated private_offer_id draft: PO-2026-03-RL-001.
Aisha: Great. I'll run a quick gating call at 11:30 to triage lint issues and lock final assets. If you can't make it, drop your attachments into the checklist and tag me. :white_check_mark:
